name: Compressive stress at 10% strain
definition: Stress at 10% strain; the test method differs between datasets (see measurement.test_method)

name: Dry density
note: d006: only on separate density blocks with unknown fungus (flag HF7)

name: Colonisation score
definition: Share of the substrate colonised, by eye: 1 = 0-5%, 2 = 6-30%, 3 = 31-69%, 4 = 70-94%, 5 = 95-100% (Musci 2025)

name: Surface colonised
definition: Share of the visible surface covered by mycelium, measured on scans (d009) or photos

name: Biological efficiency
definition: Fresh mushroom weight harvested / dry substrate weight x 100
note: d012: 1000 g dry substrate per bag, so harvest in g = BE x 10
